purpose: Small metadata comparison of exact company-facts dates and notes-archive rounded dates; no returns or stock ranking
method: Select company-facts DEI share counts filed April-June 2021 in 10-K or 10-Q; match accession and integer value to unsegmented notes num.tsv with shares units, qtrs=0 and no co-registrant. Retain keys with one company-facts end date and one notes ddate. Dates are compared as labels only.
limitations: Files were selected earlier for other diagnostics; four matched facts do not estimate universe-wide coverage or error rates.
Accession and value do not by themselves prove that two records are the same XBRL context.
Current company-facts responses are retrospective and do not establish historical availability or security-class mapping.
The notes ddate is month-end-rounded; the exact original context and filing remain the authorities for individual facts.
